value: Half-Life: Alyx is Valve's VR return to the Half-Life series, set between the events of Half-Life and Half-Life 2. Players assume the role of Alyx Vance, humanity's last hope in a desperate fight against the vicious alien Combine. As a founder of the nascent resistance alongside her father, Dr. Eli Vance, players engage in clandestine scientific activity, developing tools and uncovering weaknesses to defy the Combine's entrenched control. Built from the ground up for virtual reality, the game fully leverages VR for deep environmental interactions, intricate puzzle-solving, extensive world exploration, and visceral combat, further enhanced by included Source 2 tools for community content creation via the Steam Workshop.
